metric_definitions.top1_rate: Output of Convert/NBest rank 1 equals the primary reference surface or one of its accepted alternatives, divided by n.
metric_definitions.top5_rate: A top-5 distinct NBest result equals the primary reference surface or one of its accepted alternatives, divided by n.
metric_definitions.boundary_exact_rate: Set of bunsetsu boundary offsets in the rank-1 output equals the reference set, divided by boundary_n. The final offset is not a boundary.
metric_definitions.boundary_precision: Micro-averaged true boundary offsets divided by predicted boundary offsets.
metric_definitions.boundary_recall: Micro-averaged true boundary offsets divided by reference boundary offsets.
metric_definitions.boundary_f1: Harmonic mean of boundary_precision and boundary_recall.
metric_definitions.latency_p50_ms: Nearest-rank 50th percentile of one NBest(top_n) call per item, in milliseconds.
metric_definitions.latency_p95_ms: Nearest-rank 95th percentile of one NBest(top_n) call per item, in milliseconds.
metric_definitions.timeout_rate: Items whose one conversion call exceeded timeout_ms, divided by n. This is a threshold count, not cancellation.
